Nina (AE): BankDelta wants a 3-week BYO-key PoC. Main asks: non-exportable keys, signed rotation audit, and predictable PoC pricing. They9re PCI scoped.
Paul (CustOps): We run HSM in our vault (Entrust). Need to confirm if Redwood will ever see key material and how rotation works. Timeline: start in 10 days.
Carlos (SE): Two patterns: proxy signing (Redwood proxies calls to your HSM) or in-VPC gateway (Redwood runs gateway in your subnet). Proxy = no key export but higher latency.
Ivy (Sec): We need HSM attestation, FIPS level, firmware version, and a signed rotation statement per event. Also list of admins who can trigger rotation and MFA requirement.
Evan (Infra): Network: mTLS outbound from HSM to our proxy on 443; we will provide egress IPs and short-lived client certs for the PoC. Provide NAT/allowlist.
Carlos (SE): Rotation flow: HSM generates new key -> publish signed rotation event -> atomic metadata swap. For immediate forced rotate we can set cache TTL=0; expect short-lived tail latency.
Marta (Legal): For PoC addendum: state that Redwood does not have access to key material (proxy model), audit log delivery, retention (cust requests 5y), liability cap, and maintenance windows.
Nina (AE): Pricing: propose flat PoC fee + infra reservation; will detail numbers in SOW.
Paul (CustOps): OK. We'll send attestation bundle and contact for firewall.
Carlos (SE): I'll draft the runbook and test vectors (signature verification commands) by Fri.
Ivy (Sec): I'll list attestation artifacts and required signed rotation blob format.
Marta (Legal): I'll draft the PoC addendum.
Nina (AE): Great1 Next: Carlos to share runbook link, Evan to confirm egress IPs, Paul to share attestation. Kickoff planned in 10 days.
